description: Read-only ranked keyword search across Answers, Features, and blog posts from the NexaTabs KB. Use when you have a query; use nexatabs_list to browse without ranking, nexatabs_get for one record, nexatabs_overview for a summary. Optional locale filters Answers (en/de/fr/es). Returns query, results[{path,score,record}], total, offset, limit, nextOffset.

locale.description: Optional Answer locale filter (en, de, fr, or es for Spanish Latin America)

offset.description: Number of ranked hits to skip (default 0)

query.description: Search words, e.g. "Zen Mode" or "Save and Close"

name: nexatabs_search
title: Search NexaTabs knowledge
